_: The director's crew: who does what, which models may fill each seat, and the spending caps. Read by the web studio (lib/agents.js) and the build orchestrator (harness/director). Seats are filled live from OpenRouter's model list: the highest published intelligence inside the seat's price ceiling and abilities, one model per provider so fallbacks fail independently. `prefer` is used when the live list cannot be read.

head.job: Plans the film, talks to Sam, makes the final review. Few calls, the best judgment.

deputy.job: Reviews every step between plan and final review against the brief and the rulebook.

crew.job: Drafts: stories, scripts, shot lists, sound cues. Several drafts in parallel, the deputy keeps the best.

eyes.job: Looks at contact sheets and frames.

free.job: Last resort when every paid seat is down or the money cap is reached.

coder.job: Writes scene code (canvas/Three.js/Blender) and scores from a story and a style prototype; repairs from render errors.
